segments_b.text: Once I rose above the noise and confusion
Just to get a glimpse beyond this illusion
I was soaring ever higher
Then I flew too high
Though my eyes could see I still was a blind man
Though my mind could think I still was a madman
I hear the voices when I'm dreaming
I can hear them say
They carry on my way with song
They'll be peace when you are done
Lay your weary head to rest
Don't you cry no more
Masquerading as a man with a reason
Masquerade is the event of the season
And if I claim to be a wise man
It truly means that I don't know
On a stormy sea of moving emotion
Tossed about, I'm like a ship on the ocean
I said of course winds of fortune
But I hear voices say
Carry on my wayward son There'll be peace when you are done
Let your weary heads to rest Don't you cry no more
No more, no more, no more
Now your life's no longer empty
Surely heaven waits for you
Carry on my wayward side
There'll be peace when you are done
Let your weary heads to rest
Don't you cry no more
